verdict.rationale: The v1 API and MCP integration let an AI tool trigger scans, read vulnerability data, and triage findings programmatically, which could support scripted bulk actions, but no documentation explicitly describes a bulk-operations feature (e.g., bulk fix requests, bulk triage, or multi-select actions in the UI). missing for 10: explicit bulk-action endpoints or UI, evidence of batch processing across many findings/repos at once, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
